issues.title: The screen is blink when click role on right bottom panel
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
When I click role on right bottom panel, screen is blink

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Start a game with any role 
2. In the screen game play, click role on right bottom panel

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/8f19c089-c1dd-44aa-b9b5-9a69eab94bd1)

3.  Notice screen is blink 

See below screencast for more details 

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Screen should not blink when click anywhere

## 🖥️ Screencast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/da95b4c4-f893-46ed-8c44-a3faf4a531ce
